title: Regex lab
description: Run regular expressions against texts, see where they match and which expectations pass, and fix them.
needs: an object with regexes ([{ id, pattern, flags }]) and texts ([{ id, text, expect: { regex id: "match" | "no-match" } }]), at least one of each

tools.name: setRegex
tools.description: Change a regex's pattern and flags.

tools.name: addRegex
tools.description: Add a regex; it gets the next free id (r1, r2, …).

tools.name: removeRegex
tools.description: Remove a regex and the expectations that name it.

tools.name: reorderRegexes
tools.description: Move a regex to a position (0 is first).

tools.name: addText
tools.description: Add a text to test against; it gets the next free id (t1, t2, …).

tools.name: reorderTexts
tools.description: Move a text to a position (0 is first).

tools.name: setExpectation
tools.description: Say whether a regex should match a text: match, no-match, or none to clear it.

tools.name: grid
tools.description: Every text × regex: whether the regex matches, what is expected and whether that passes.

tools.name: explainMatches
tools.description: Where a regex matches a text: each match's position, text and capture groups.
